purpose: Teach: 書き手/読み上げ/意気込み/組み合わせる/梱包/別紙/試料/春休み

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 記事の書き手、若手から、育てろ。
lines.en: Start developing article writers from the younger staff.
lines.style: Measured and direct. Clear authority without harshness. Pauses slightly after 'writers' to let the instruction settle. Even pacing, deliberate.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。役員会の冒頭、社訓、読み上げ予定です。
lines.en: Yes. We'll read through the company creed at the opening of the executive meeting.
lines.style: Steady, professional acknowledgment. Speaks with quiet competence. Slight emphasis on 'company creed' — showing he understands the weight of it. No rush.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新人の意気込み、感じるよ。
lines.en: I can feel the enthusiasm from the new hires.
lines.style: Observational, almost quiet approval. Warm undertone. Speaks as though noticing something that matters. Slightly slower — savoring the observation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。異業種の知見、組み合わせる試み、進めます。
lines.en: Yes. We're moving forward with combining insights from different industries.
lines.style: Clear, forward-focused delivery. Confident without overstatement. Slight emphasis on 'combining' — showing initiative. Steady rhythm.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: Shipping and packing — make sure it's handled carefully.
lines.style: Firm, non-negotiable. Short, clipped opening. Pause after 'packing.' Weight on 'carefully.' Boss-to-staff tone, but not unkind.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。詳細は、別紙、ご参照ください。
lines.en: Yes. The details are in the attached document for your reference.
lines.style: Professional, matter-of-fact. Brisk efficiency. Directs without elaborating. Tone suggests this is straightforward protocol.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 品質試料、研究所に送ったか。
lines.en: Did you send the quality samples to the lab?
lines.style: Direct check-in. Slight uptick at the end — genuinely asking for confirmation, not accusatory. Measured pace. Waits for answer.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。春休み明け、結果が出ます。
lines.en: Yes. We'll have the results back after spring break.
lines.style: Calm, factual. Speaks with certainty about the timeline. Slight trailing-off — routine matter now established. Even pacing.
